paper.title: Logarithmic Regret for Unconstrained Submodular Maximization Stochastic Bandit

settings.name_in_paper: Online unconstrained submodular maximization (Online USM) with stochastic full-bandit feedback
unmapped: Reward function f is a possibly non-monotone submodular set function over all subsets of d items, with values in a known interval [0,c]
Regret is the 1/2-approximate pseudo-regret sum_t [f(A*)/2 - f(A_t)]
settings.definition_quote: The player receives noisy rewards from a non monotone submodular set-function $f: \cP(\cD)\rightarrow [0, c]$ with $c>0$. At each round $t\in[T]$, the player chooses an action $A_t\in\cP(\cD)$ and receives $Z_t = f(A_t) + \eta_t$, where $\eta_t$ is a random variable. Let $\sigma>0$ (known), we assume that $\eta_t$ is $\sigma^2$-sub-Gaussian conditionally to the past

symbols.H_f: global DG-hardness, sum over items of local DG-hardness h_{f,i} (depends on item ordering)

tuning: confidence parameter delta > 0; bound holds with probability >= 1 - 10 delta/T

source.label: th:DGETC
source.quote: Then, with probability greater than $1-10\delta/T$, \DGETC satisfies $R_T \leq C_1\min\Big\{H_f\log(dT),\ dT^{2/3}\log(dT)^{1/3}\Big\}$, where $C_1$ is a constant independent from $d$, $T$ and $\delta$.

results.notes: R_T is the 1/2-approximate pseudo-regret. Constant C_1 independent of d,T,delta (may depend on c, sigma).

symbols.H_f: global DG-hardness, sum over items of local DG-hardness h_{f,i} (depends on item ordering)

source.label: th:DGETC
source.quote: Likewise, in expectation, $\bE[R_T] \leq C_2 \min\Big\{H_f\log(dT),\ dT^{2/3}\log(dT)^{1/3}\Big\}$, where $C_1$ is a constant independent from $d$ and $T$.

results.notes: Expected 1/2-approximate pseudo-regret; proof sketch says choosing delta=1 yields the expectation bound. Includes worst-case O(dT^{2/3}log(dT)^{1/3}).

symbols.sum_items: sum over the d items i in [d]

tuning: confidence parameter delta > 0; bound holds with probability >= 1 - 10 delta/T

source.quote: We can get more fine-grained bounds by using the local DG-hardnesses instead of the global one. ... with probability at least $1-10\delta/T$ $R_T\leq C_3 \sum_{i\in[d]}\min\Big\{h_{f,i}\log(dT),\ T^{2/3}\log(dT)^{1/3}\Big\}$, where $C_3$ is a constant independent from $d$, $T$ and $\delta$.

results.notes: Stated in a remark as a refinement of Theorem 2; conditions assumed same as Theorem 2.
